description: This file defines the interface IButler within the WPEFramework project's Exchange namespace. It declares methods for managing value points, notifications for changes, and resource management such as registration, element access, and manipulation operations.

classes.name: IButler
classes.description: Interface for managing and monitoring value points, including registration and element access within the WPEFramework system.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving notifications about changes in value points such as addition, removal, updates, and metadata changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink to receive updates about value point changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink from receiving updates.

methods.name: Element (by name)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IValuePoint element identified by its name.

methods.name: Element (by id)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IValuePoint element identified by its numerical ID.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Returns the source information related to a specified module.

methods.name: Branch
methods.description: Retrieves the branch node corresponding to the specified path.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Creates a link between a path and an ID.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves or renames a resource from one path to another.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the resource at the specified path.

methods.name: Orphans
methods.description: Returns an iterator over orphaned value points for a specific module.

calls: Link(const string& path, const uint32_t id)
Move(const string& path, const string& newName)
